name: Baltimore
local_rules: Baltimore requires a 'Petition for Trial' to be requested within 30 days of the citation. If the citation is older than 45 days, the City of Baltimore loses jurisdiction and the appeal must be filed directly with the District Court of Maryland (700 E. Patapsco Avenue). Always include the 10-digit citation number on your check or petition to ensure correct routing between the City and the State Court system.
